mainLogo.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: standalone production mascot logo for PACE, an AI agent workspace.
Primary request: Design ONE original adorable white puppy HEAD ONLY as a distinctive brand icon. Reference design language: bold black rounded hand-drawn contour, sparse expressive face, white filled interior, true transparent exterior, playful premium open-source software mascot. Original character identity: asymmetrical side-swept three-lobed tuft, one small triangular folded ear and one soft hanging ear, rounded slightly squarish cheeks, two solid oval eyes, little triangular nose, small closed off-center smile. A confident calm helper. Avoid the curly bichon look of OpenUI; use a visibly different silhouette and face.
Style: exceptionally clean flat hand-inked graphic, deliberately varied but smooth thick black strokes and rounded endpoints. Black and opaque white ONLY. Composition: head fills 82% of square, precisely centered, generous safe margin, no clipping. Must be readable at 24-32px. No text, no letters, no wordmark, no collar, no accessories, no body, no background, no shadow, no watermark. Exterior genuinely transparent; white face stays opaque.
